component.name: onspot
component.summary: Practise speaking a language and get a teacher's feedback

description.p: onspot gives you a topic, listens to you talk for a minute, then marks what you said the way a good teacher would: every mistake pinned to the exact words you used, explained in plain language, and read back to you the way a native speaker would say it.

ul.li: Speak first: a prompt, a microphone and one minute, no multiple choice
Corrections for grammar, vocabulary, connectors and naturalness
Hear the corrected version read aloud
Speech recognition and voices can run entirely on your device
Optional cloud providers use your own API keys
Your history stays in a database you own, with export and cloud sync

description.p: French is ready; Japanese is in development.

screenshot.caption: French practice with a teacher's feedback
Practice and feedback on a phone

description.p: A setup page, practice reminders, transcript export and a bigger icon.

ul.li: A first-run setup page connects your coach and chooses how corrections sound; reopen it from Settings.
Optional practice reminders, notices when language data finishes downloading, and Markdown export of a session.
Dark mode gets depth from lighter surfaces, and the background glare follows casual or exam mode.
A bigger app icon without the black tile.

description.p: Smoother on phones, text sizes you set on a live preview, and fixes.

ul.li: Sheets, lists and scrolling keep up with 120 Hz screens: paper textures are images now, and nothing repaints the page while it scrolls.
On phones the bar has two rows, swiping up on it opens Feedback, and the session stats close on a tap or stay pinned.
Set the text size of each part of a take on a live preview of a session, per screen size and take length.
One button for the playback speed, word meanings that match their words, and dropdowns that fit the screen.

description.p: Phone gestures, a Back button and branded installers.

ul.li: On phones, swipe the Feedback sheet down to close it, and swipe sideways between feedback filters and Settings tabs.
A Back button on every page but Practice; it closes what is open first, like Android's Back.
The installers for Windows and macOS carry the onspot icon and artwork, and the Android icon fits every launcher shape.

description.p: Installers for ARM and Intel, an own title bar, and automatic model choice.

ul.li: Windows, macOS and Linux installers for both x64 and ARM64, including Intel Macs and an ARM Flatpak.
A thin title bar that follows light and dark mode; the AppImage resizes correctly under Wayland.
Automatic choice of the language model by language, request size and rate limits.
Hear a selected phrase, and show or hide the corrections in "Did you mean to say?".

description.p: Long takes, steadier cloud and on-device speech, a faster interface and a new app icon.

ul.li: Takes of several minutes: parts of a card fold, and "Did you mean to say?" can list only the fixes.
Groq requests are paced to each model's limits and move to another free model when one is busy.
On-device speech reads long texts in sentence pieces.
A new logo and app icon.
